Structural presence does not establish operational reachability.
decisions.violated_obligation: Motion beginning must be able to enter Accelerating within the reachable InMotion scope.

decisions.basis: Pair-0014 dossier: NL9 progress clause and exact Approaching reachability/outgoing-transition facts.
decisions.reason: The clause requires the system to continue approaching the destination. The exact state:Approaching:line:14 is unreachable from the top-level initial entry, so the required operating behavior cannot occur in reachable behavior. The supplied two outgoing transitions show this is not a local no-outgoing dead end, but they do not rebut the separate reachability obligation.
decisions.violated_obligation: Approaching must be reachable and able to continue operating toward the destination.

decisions.basis: Pair-0014 dossier: NL9 Send-effect clause and exact Approaching effect inventory.
decisions.reason: The clause requires Approaching to send the Send signal. The exact state:Approaching:line:14 is present, but the supplied state and outgoing-transition effect inventory contains no Send action or effect. Approach-related source annotations do not establish an executable effect.
decisions.violated_obligation: Approaching must emit the Send signal.

result.reason: All 23 required obligation IDs are represented exactly once. Exact source/model facts establish first-violation readings for the listed malformed entries, missing actions/effects, unreachable scopes/consumers, missing guards, and the initial-transition invariant. The Approaching completion-boundary dossier remains semantically unresolved because it lacks a condition-specific termination fact or proof; unsupported predicates and backend uncertainty were not treated as semantic defeaters.

issues.basis: NL1; exact_source_inventory state DoorsClosing; FCSTM transition:line:34 targets state:UnspecifiedInitial:line:9; verify check initial-entry:transition:line:34.
issues.expected: The top-level initial edge must enter state:DoorsClosing:line:10.
issues.observed: The top-level initial edge transition:line:34 enters state:UnspecifiedInitial:line:9.
issues.reason: The exact root initial transition targets UnspecifiedInitial rather than the required DoorsClosing state. The required target and root scope are exact, and the complete initial-edge inventory supplies the counterexample.
issues.requirement_quote: The system starts in the DoorsClosing state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model contains DoorsClosing and a valid DoorsClosing-to-InMotion transition, but no supplied fact equates UnspecifiedInitial with DoorsClosing or supplies another root initial edge.

issues.basis: NL5; exact source transition tr_0002; closed transition:line:15 with scope InMotion, target Accelerating, and trigger Entry_Accelerate; verify initial-entry refutation for transition:line:15.
issues.expected: InMotion's initial entry must default to Accelerating without a trigger.
issues.observed: transition:line:15 enters state:Accelerating:line:12 but has trigger Entry_Accelerate.
issues.reason: The exact InMotion-owned initial edge reaches Accelerating but carries the Entry_Accelerate trigger. The supplied initial-entry fact explicitly refutes unconditional/default entry semantics, so the endpoint itself is not treated as missing.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The edge reaches the required target and the trigger text corresponds to the authored Entry/Accelerate label, but the deterministic fact still records a triggered initial edge rather than an unconditional default.
issues.title: InMotion initial entry is conditional

issues.basis: NL3; source_trace trace:body:EmergencyStopping.Entry:4; FCSTM state:EmergencyStopping:line:27 and state:Entry:line:28; reference action inventory count is zero.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping must execute action Emergency Stop.
issues.observed: No closed-model action is recorded for EmergencyStopping or its Entry lifecycle carrier.
issues.reason: EmergencyStopping is an exact closed-model composite mapped to the authored source root, but the closed model exposes no lifecycle action carrier for the required Emergency Stop behavior. The Entry child only carries a body annotation and no executable action inventory is supplied.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The FCSTM preserves the text as a body annotation on Entry, but that annotation is not a supplied executable action fact.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping lacks its required action

issues.basis: NL3; source_trace trace:body:EmergencyStopping:3; FCSTM state:EmergencyStopping:line:27; closed transition effects and action inventory; exact source event inventory.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping must send the Obstacle Detected signal as a state effect.
issues.observed: No state or entry effect emits Obstacle Detected; the closed model only declares the event and uses it as a trigger.
issues.reason: The exact EmergencyStopping source/model root is present, but the closed transition effects and state action inventory contain no Obstacle Detected emission associated with entering or operating EmergencyStopping. The only supplied Obstacle_Detected uses are transition triggers and route-control effects on outgoing branches.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model contains the Obstacle_Detected event declaration and an authored body annotation, but declaration and annotation do not establish a closed-model state effect.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping lacks its required signal effect

issues.basis: NL10; exact source state InMotion.Approaching; closed transitions line 21 and line 24 target [*], with parent continuation represented by lines 32 and 33; source body annotations identify Nearing Destination and Ready to Stop/Decelerate.
issues.expected: Approaching must complete with a terminating response at the ready-to-stop/decelerate boundary.
issues.observed: Approaching's supplied transitions terminate only to [*] and are selected by Arrived_Stop_SendArrived or Obstacle_Detected; no transition is tied to the supplied ready-to-stop/decelerate condition.
issues.reason: The exact Approaching state has completion transitions on Arrived/Stop, SendArrived and Obstacle Detected, but the supplied closed model routes these through the InMotion completion pseudostate and then out to parent-level transitions. The required condition-specific terminating response is therefore not represented as a stable terminal completion of Approaching itself.
issues.requirement_quote: until it is ready to stop or decelerate
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The model does provide exit transitions from Approaching and parent-level stopping/emergency routes, but no supplied fact establishes that these routes implement the specific NL completion boundary.
issues.title: Approaching termination boundary is not modeled as a stable completion

issues.basis: NL1; exact_source_inventory transition tr_0001 and state DoorsClosing; closed transition:line:34; closed state state:DoorsClosing:line:10; verify initial-entry and reachability facts.
issues.expected: The root system initial edge enters DoorsClosing.
issues.observed: The root initial edge targets UnspecifiedInitial; DoorsClosing is unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The closed model's root initial transition targets UnspecifiedInitial rather than DoorsClosing. DoorsClosing is an exact closed-model state, and the complete initial-entry/reachability facts confirm the required root entry is not realized.
issues.requirement_quote: The system starts in the DoorsClosing state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The separate DoorsClosing-to-InMotion transition exists, but it is event-driven and cannot substitute for the required root initial edge.
issues.title: Root Initial Entry Targets the Wrong State

issues.basis: NL5; exact_source_inventory transition tr_0002; closed transition:line:15; verify check initial-entry:transition:line:15; inspection diagnostic INITIAL_ENTRY_CONDITIONAL.
issues.expected: The InMotion owner-local initial entry unconditionally targets Accelerating.
issues.observed: The owner-local initial edge targets Accelerating only with trigger Entry_Accelerate.
issues.reason: The exact InMotion-local initial edge reaches Accelerating but carries the Entry_Accelerate trigger. The deterministic initial-entry fact marks this owner-local entry conditional, so it does not establish the required default beginning in Accelerating.
issues.requirement_quote: The system begins in the Accelerating substate
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The target state and edge exist exactly, but the supplied requirement is a default initial entry and the trigger remains present.
issues.title: InMotion Default Entry Is Conditional

issues.basis: NL8; exact source transition tr_0002; closed transition:line:15; event-consumer Entry_Accelerate; reachability state:InMotion:line:11 and state:Accelerating:line:12.
issues.expected: Motion beginning can enter Accelerating within the reachable InMotion scope.
issues.observed: The Entry_Accelerate consumer exists but is unreachable because InMotion and Accelerating are unreachable from the root initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact InMotion initial carrier targets Accelerating and consumes Entry_Accelerate, but the closed model's root initial path never reaches InMotion. The event-consumer fact confirms the declared consumer exists but has no reachable consumer from the top-level initial entry.
issues.requirement_quote: The system enters the Accelerating substate when motion begins, marked by the "Entry/Accelerate" action.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The owner-local edge and event consumer are structurally present; the defect is the supplied finite root-reachability result, not missing source or model identity.
issues.title: Motion-Begin Entry Is Operationally Unreachable

issues.basis: NL9; exact source state InMotion.Approaching; closed state state:Approaching:line:14; verify reachability refutation; inspection outgoing transitions line 21 and line 24.
issues.expected: Approaching is reachable and can continue operating toward the destination.
issues.observed: Approaching is unreachable from the top-level initial entry, although its closed-model state has stop and obstacle outgoing transitions.
issues.reason: The provided finite reachability facts show Approaching is unreachable from the top-level initial entry, so its required operating progress cannot occur in the closed model's reachable behavior. This is a reachability consequence for the exact required operating state, not a claim that Approaching is a local dead end; it has outgoing transitions.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The state is not locally deadlocked: the supplied inventory lists two outgoing transitions. The candidate concerns operational unreachability of the required behavior, not a local no-outgoing defect.
issues.title: Required Approaching Behavior Is Unreachable

issues.basis: NL9; exact_source_inventory state InMotion.Approaching and body projections; closed FCSTM state state:Approaching:line:14; owned transition inventory for Approaching has only Arrived_Stop_SendArrived and Obstacle_Detected effects.
issues.observed: No Send effect is present in the supplied closed-model state or its outgoing transition effects.
issues.reason: The exact Approaching state is present, but the supplied closed-model inventory contains no Send action or effect on that state or its transitions. This is a state effect obligation whose semantic value is not represented by a registered frozen predicate input.
issues.requirement_quote: In the Approaching substate, the system sends the "Send" signal
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The source body contains approach-related annotations, but source annotations do not establish a closed-model executable Send effect.
issues.title: Approaching Lacks the Required Send Effect

issues.basis: NL3; exact source states EmergencyStopping and EmergencyStopping.Entry; closed states state:EmergencyStopping:line:27 and state:Entry:line:28; closed nested initial transition:line:30; action inventory count 0.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping performs the Emergency Stop action.
issues.observed: No executable action is supplied, and the Entry state carrying the source annotation is unreachable from EmergencyStopping's initial edge.
issues.reason: EmergencyStopping is present as an exact closed-model composite and its Entry child is present, but the supplied model facts expose no executable action carrier for the required Emergency Stop action. The Entry child is also unreachable because EmergencyStopping's initial edge targets a synthetic unspecified state.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The PlantUML body names Emergency Stop, but the supplied action inventory is empty and source annotation alone does not prove executable behavior.
issues.title: Emergency Stop Action Is Not Executable

issues.basis: NL3; source state EmergencyStopping body; closed state state:EmergencyStopping:line:27; transition effects line 22-24 are route-token assignments, not EmergencyStopping effects; action/effect inventory is not supplied as a matching signal emission.
issues.expected: EmergencyStopping sends the Obstacle Detected signal.
issues.observed: The closed model contains no EmergencyStopping effect emitting Obstacle Detected; obstacle transitions only assign R45RouteToken = 7 before routing.
issues.reason: The closed model has obstacle-triggered transitions and route-token effects, but no state effect carrier on EmergencyStopping that emits Obstacle Detected. The exact state is bound, and the supplied effect inventory does not provide the required signal.
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The event is declared and consumed by obstacle transitions, but that is distinct from emitting the required signal from EmergencyStopping.
issues.title: EmergencyStopping Lacks the Required Signal Effect

issues.basis: NL3; source transition tr_0007; closed transition:line:33 and target state:EmergencyStopping:line:27; Obstacle_Detected event consumer refs transition:line:22-24; reachability refutations for InMotion and EmergencyStopping.
issues.expected: Obstacle detection selects a reachable transition into EmergencyStopping.
issues.observed: Obstacle consumers are declared and structurally present, but all are unreachable from the top-level initial entry.
issues.reason: The exact InMotion-to-EmergencyStopping endpoint and obstacle event consumer exist, but both the InMotion scope and EmergencyStopping target are unreachable from the root initial entry. The event-consumer facts therefore show declaration and consumption without reachable operational coverage.
issues.requirement_quote: When an obstacle is detected, the system enters the EmergencyStopping state
issues.strongest_rebuttal: The endpoint and event are both present in the closed inventory; the candidate is limited to reachable operational coverage.
issues.title: Obstacle Response Has No Reachable Consumer
